notes.title: Sonny Legacy Collection Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of the [i]Sonny Legacy Collection[/i] on Steam! This collection brings together the iconic Sonny 1 & Sonny 2 RPG series, featuring quality of life updates, achievements and all the nostalgic elements fans know and love.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/2757720/Sonny_Legacy_Collection/

Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the series, this collection offers hours of strategy, action, and unforgettable storytelling.

Join Sonny on his epic journey as he battles enemies, levels up, and uncovers the mysteries of his past.
Get ready to dive into the world of Sonny today — available now on Steam!

notes.title: v1.06 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*]End music now plays for SHIFT 4
[*]Crashing SHIFT 4 is now much harder; if you crash it, it's your fault now
[*]A few additional very minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Shift Legacy Collection Now Available
notes.notes:
Calling all Shifty’s! 

We are thrilled with all the positive feedback from fans new and old! We are overjoyed to have the game released, so if you haven't picked up a copy, now is the perfect time. Also; If you enjoyed the game, please leave us a review; it really helps!

We also just pushed v1.01 live that addresses crashes when returning to the menu in Shift 1, 2 and 3. We're aware of this same issue in Shift 4 and an issue with the Shift 4 ending music, both of which will be fixed very soon! 

Shift Legacy Collection has also joined the Colossal Classics Bundle; so if you want to Escape, Sleep, Crush, Stand and Ride your way to a retro tomorrow, consider picking it up.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25392/Colossal_Classics_Bundle/

Remember when Shift hits the Fan, Shake it off! 

Happy Shifting!

-The Armor Games Studios Team
